name: runbook-restart-service
description: Restart an inventory service safely: pre-checks (status, health probe, recent logs, maintenance window) as a baseline, human approval, the restart (service_control), then verification against the baseline. Fails, with the evidence, when the service does not come back healthy.

precheck.title: Pre-checks (baseline)
precheck.prompt:
Pre-checks for restarting service {{input.service}} (reason: {{input.reason}}). Read-only: service_control action status, probe the service, logs_search its last 15 minutes for errors (and keep the messages: they are lost on restart), docker_status or host_stats for its host, and ops_inventory for its maintenance windows.

Report: the baseline (state, health, restarts, probe latency, error lines), whether it is inside a maintenance window, and whether a restart is likely to help (a crash loop or a full disk will not be fixed by it - say so).

restart.title: Restart
restart.prompt:
A person approved restarting {{input.service}}. Run service_control action restart for it, once, and nothing else.

Report: the tool's before/after output.

verify.title: Verify
